newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices lower in volatile conditions.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices lower in volatile conditions.

text.p: Arabica prices in the Bremen coffee market were $4-7 down on the week per 50 kg fob as a result of a technical correction on the futures which had hit 2-1/2 highs last week.
But Kenyans rose $5 to $300 on overseas buying demand.
Buyers initially were put off by the high volatility as they did not know when to commit themselves, traders said.

But they noted some second hand sales and roaster interest in arabicas replacing Colombians at Wednesday's and Thursday's lows. New York coffee bounced back at Friday midday on short covering. Hamburg traders reported robustas and Brazil sales.
